channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Kevyn Aucoin Luxury Cosmetic
channel.desc: Discover Kevin Aucoin's iconic cosmetics to upgrade your beauty bag in an instant. One of the most influential make-up artists of all time, Kevin has created a legacy of beauty you'll simply adore.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: OPI Professional Nailcare
channel.desc: As one of the world's largest manufacturers of professional nail products, OPI is a must-have for anyone wanting salon-quality results in their own home.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Percy and Reed Haircare
channel.desc: Percy and Reed brings you new haircare products you always needed but could never find and they only create products which work - bringing British individuality and their own style to your hair.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Floral Street Fragrance
channel.desc: Dive into the essence of modern British fragrance with Floral Street. Founded by beauty powerhouse Michelle Feeney, explore scents that champion eco-responsibility at their core.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Beauty Steals and Deals
channel.desc: Love beauty? Tune in to see the latest deals and bag a beauty bargain. We've got an exciting array of popular and iconic brands plus cult products you're sure to adore.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Nakery Beauty
channel.desc: Nakery Beauty delivers clean, high-performance skincare and bodycare designed to empower confidence at every age.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: In the Salon with Gatineau
channel.desc: Professional beauty products from the pioneering skincare specialists. Gatineau combines the highest quality plant and marine extracts with the very latest cutting-edge biotechnology.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Beauty Tech with Legology
channel.desc: Upgrade your routine with beauty tech and Legology. Discover innovative tools and body care favourites designed to help you feel pampered, polished and confident.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Decleor Paris
channel.desc: A selection of products from world famous French skincare company Decleor that feature highly concentrated essential oils to offer a pure and natural treat for your face and body.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Doll10 Beauty
channel.desc: the pioneer in age reversal beauty and a combination of breakthrough technologies, age transforming complexes and real life make-up techniques.
